name: popover
title: Popover
lead: Show rich contextual content anchored to a trigger.

variants.title: Title and content
variants.description: Popover extends Tooltip with a header/body and defaults to click. The generated role is tooltip, with aria-describedby; it is not a dialog or expanded-state controller.
variants.markup: <button class="btn-outline theme-inverse" type="button" data-trm-toggle="popover" data-trm-title="Project status" data-trm-content="Ready for review by the design team." >Show project status</button>

variants.title: Preferred placement
variants.description: Use top/right/bottom/left or breakpoint-prefixed variants. Unsupported standalone start/end values are not logical aliases in this pinned implementation.

variants.title: Focus dismissal
variants.description: A focus trigger dismisses on outside pointer/focus departure. Clicking or focusing inside the popover is not treated as outside. Default click-only popovers do not share that policy.
variants.markup: <button class="btn-outline theme-inverse" type="button" data-trm-toggle="popover" data-trm-title="Context" data-trm-content="Focus-based supporting information." id="focus-popover" data-trm-trigger="focus">Focus for details</button>

variants.title: Static specimen
variants.description: Static styling specimen includes header/body only; no generated trigger relationship, focus management or dismissal is implied.
variants.markup:
Deployment

Production was updated recently.

variants.title: HTML content
variants.description: Text is the default; this example explicitly enables sanitized strong text. Data attributes cannot disable the security allowlist.
variants.markup: <button class="btn-outline theme-inverse" type="button" data-trm-toggle="popover" data-trm-title="Release" data-trm-content="<strong>v0.8</strong> is ready" data-trm-html="true">Show release</button>

variants.title: Disabled control wrapper
variants.description: Use a named focusable wrapper and hover/focus triggers rather than pretending a disabled native button can open its own popover.

variants.title: Dark mode and RTL
variants.description: Explicit container placement retains local theme tokens in generated output; right/left direction resolution follows the document.

keyboard.behavior: Activate a native button to toggle a click-trigger popover.
Dismiss a visible popover without moving focus; the first Escape inside a dialog closes only the tip.
Use native focus order. Focus-trigger dismissal differs from default click; there is no focus trap or automatic focus transfer into content.

guidelines: Keep content concise and supplemental. Complex tasks and critical confirmations belong in a Dialog.
Default trigger is click and placement right; outside dismissal requires a focus-trigger policy, not an assumed universal handler.
Generated role=tooltip content is described by aria-describedby, not aria-expanded. The plugin does not manage a modal scope or content focus order.
The core lazily initializes data hooks; this site explicitly initializes examples before first interaction. Explicit module initialization is available.
Preserve sanitization and prefer text. sanitize/allowList/sanitizeFn cannot be configured through data attributes.
The default body container is redirected to an open ancestor dialog; custom containers must remain inside the correct top layer/theme.
show/hide starts are cancelable; inserted occurs after DOM insertion, and shown/hidden wait for transition callbacks and cleanup.

example: <button class="btn-outline theme-inverse" type="button" data-trm-toggle="popover" data-trm-title="Project status" data-trm-content="This project is ready for review." id="example-popover">Show popover</button>

events.shown.trm.popover: On the trigger after the entry transition callback.

The module sample below creates the instance; the configured triggers or an explicit show() call reveal it. Floating UI must be available.

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
lead: Provide short supporting descriptions on hover and keyboard focus.

variants.title: Preferred trigger
variants.description: Default hover and focus triggers provide pointer/keyboard access. The documentation explicitly initializes examples on DOMContentLoaded; construction alone does not show a tip.

variants.title: Placement
variants.description: Use top/right/bottom/left, not standalone start/end. This pin mirrors right/left through its document-direction attachment map; Floating UI may flip or shift the result.

variants.title: Responsive placement
variants.description: Viewport breakpoint prefixes use the actual Floating UI helper. Resizing updates a visible tip; preferred placement is not a guarantee when the viewport clips it.
variants.markup: <button class="btn-outline theme-inverse" type="button" data-trm-toggle="tooltip" data-trm-title="Responsive positioning" data-trm-placement="top md:right lg:bottom">Responsive tooltip</button>

variants.title: Static specimen
variants.description: Styling only: no generated ID, trigger relationship or controller is implied by a static specimen. Essential instructions remain visible elsewhere.
variants.markup: Keyboard shortcut: Ctrl + K

variants.title: Disabled control wrapper
variants.description: The wrapper is named and keyboard focusable because a native disabled control cannot receive focus. This is a deliberate extra focus stop, not a substitute for visible permission guidance.

variants.title: Sanitized HTML
variants.description: html=true allows a limited allowlist; default remains text. Security options cannot be disabled by data attributes. Keep templates/content trusted and sanitization enabled.
variants.markup: <button class="btn-outline theme-inverse" type="button" data-trm-toggle="tooltip" data-trm-title="<strong>Review</strong> before publishing" data-trm-html="true">Formatted help</button>

variants.title: Instant animation
variants.description: animation=false adds the actual tooltip-instant class to generated output; it does not introduce a fade class.
variants.markup: <button class="btn-outline theme-inverse" type="button" data-trm-toggle="tooltip" data-trm-title="Immediate supplemental help" data-trm-animation="false">Instant help</button>

variants.title: Dark mode and RTL
variants.description: An explicit container keeps the generated tip inside this local theme. Placement uses document direction, not merely this wrapper direction.

keyboard.behavior: Focus enters/leaves default focus triggers; hovering the tip can keep it open.
Dismiss the visible tip without moving focus. Inside a dialog, the tip consumes the first Escape.

guidelines: Use concise supplemental information on a named native focusable trigger; never make a tip the only source of essential instructions.
The core has lazy data-API initialization. For deterministic first-interaction behavior, explicitly initialize triggers, as this site does.
Floating UI is required; use the bundle or resolve the dependency in a module build.
Generated output gets a unique ID and aria-describedby. The pin replaces/removes this attribute; do not assume it merges an existing description list.
Default hover/focus behavior keeps the tip accessible while pointer/focus remains relevant; Escape dismisses without moving focus.
Plain text is the default. HTML/template input uses the approved sanitizer; sanitize/allowList/sanitizeFn cannot come from data attributes.
Interactive content may be technically supported, but a role=tooltip is not a modal task or a focus-managed dialog. Prefer visible help or a Dialog for complex controls.

example: <button class="btn-outline theme-inverse" type="button" data-trm-toggle="tooltip" data-trm-title="Copy project link" id="example-tooltip">Hover or focus</button>
